title: speech.state body v1
description: Speech output state. Publisher: jv-voice. State topic: envelope conf = 1.0. Emitted on every transition; 'interrupted' is followed by 'idle' or the next 'speaking'.

say_id.description: The speech.say output (say_id) this transition concerns. Absent only for the initial idle on startup.

reason.description: Why the previous utterance ended. Present on transitions out of 'speaking'.
